trained_by: the original notebook sst2_project.ipynb (git tag 'original'), before this pipeline existed

sources.revision: the snapshot in the local Hugging Face cache that the notebook loaded (the notebook itself did not pin one)
sources.seed: Trainer default; applied after the classification head was initialised, so the head's initial weights were not seeded
sources.device: printed by the notebook's environment-check cell
sources.train_runtime_seconds: Trainer progress bar in the output of the DistilBERT training cell (wall clock, including any idle time such as the computer sleeping)
sources.checkpoint_saved_at: modification times of checkpoint-*/trainer_state.json on the author's machine
sources.versions: notebook metadata and the environment-check cell
